name: @arborxr/mcp-server
stderr:
Error: ARBORXR_API_TOKEN environment variable is required.

To use the ArborXR MCP server, you need to provide your API token:

  1. Generate an API token from the ArborXR dashboard:
     https://developers.arborxr.com/docs/how-to-generate-an-access-token/

  2. Set it as an environment variable:

     export ARBORXR_API_TOKEN="your-token-here"

  Or add it to your MCP client configuration:

     "env": { "ARBORXR_API_TOKEN": "your-token-here" }
